title: 第19章 真菌第20章 有人来了
slug: 废墟探险家第325章回魂芭
content_zh:
“没什么”
白芑在通讯耳机里发出了邀请，“如果你有兴趣可以来看看，我就在你隔壁。”
“我马上过去”
虞娓娓给出回应之后不久，她便已经举着手电筒从隔壁跑了过来。
“做好心理准备”
白芑指了指身后，“那里有一具白骨化的尸体。”
“我知道”虞娓娓说话间已经和白芑错身而过。
“你知道？”
白芑只是一瞬间的错愕便反应过来，这个姑娘既然能找到这里，九成九是当年来过这里的人的“指引”。
那么当年来过的那个人，会不会就是杀死墙角那个人的凶手呢？
答案几乎是肯定，但是谁**在乎？
“这个人是个来自捷克斯洛伐克的间谍，他实际上为法国工作，而且在1992年春天就失踪了。”
虞娓娓说着，已经将手电筒放在一边，从胸前的口袋里拿出一把医疗剪刀，动作麻利的剪开了尸体身上的西装。
而刚刚那一番话，却是在她触碰这具尸体之前说的，这更加印证了白芑之前的猜测。
“这是我能听的？”白芑追问道。
“难道你还准备去鸡腐警察局报警吗？”
虞娓娓开了并不算多么好笑的玩笑，“他窃取的是苏...把门关上吧。”
白芑愣了一下，迈步走到门口，关上了厚重的防爆门。
“他窃取的是苏联医学科学院的科研成果”
虞娓娓继续用汉语说道，“是关于1986年切尔诺贝利事故之后相关研究的科研成果。”

“你确定是我能听的？”
白芑再次问道，他和这个气质清冷的漂亮姑娘可实在不算熟人。
“既然决定拉你入伙，总要让你知道一些内情。”
虞娓娓解释道，“除非你在完成这次合作之后选择不再参与，所以要继续听吗？”
闻言，白芑下意识的看向了周围的机柜，随后毫不犹豫的点点头，“当然，只要不会给你们惹麻烦也不会给我自己以及我的家人惹麻烦，干嘛不听？”
“不会惹麻烦的”
虞娓娓摇摇头，将身旁这具尸骨身上找到的东西一一摆在地板上继续说道，“科研内容是一种可以吸收核辐射，而且对辐射利用效率非常高的新型隐球菌。”
“咳咳...那个...”
白芑不得不打断了对方的解释，“你学什么专业的？”
“医学生物化学，怎么了？”虞娓娓不解的看向白芑。
“我职高的时候学的是汽修专业”
白芑自嘲的摊摊手，“就算我姑父找人帮我在俄罗斯买的那所野鸡大学的文凭，也是重型设备维修专业。”
“我明白了”
虞娓娓带着歉意重新解释道，“简单的说，这是一种疑似原始生长在切尔诺贝利核事故现场高辐射区的真菌。
它能吸收核辐射转化成能...转化成肥料，没错，自身生长的肥料。”
“这么厉害？”
白芑瞪大了眼睛，“所以只要在切尔诺贝利和辐岛种满这种真菌...不，辐岛就算了。”
“结局趋同，但是过程绝对没有你想的那么简单。”
虞娓娓尽量用白芑能听懂的方式解释道，“它本质还是真菌，对人类有一定危险的真菌，而且培养这种真菌并不像你想的那么简单。”
content_en:
“Nothing”
Bai Qi sent an invitation through the communication headset, "If you are interested, you can come and have a look. I will be next door to you."
"I'll be there right away"
Not long after Yu Weiwei responded, she ran over from next door with a flashlight.
"Be mentally prepared"
Bai Zhi pointed behind him, "There is a skeletal corpse there."
"I know." Yu Weiwei had already passed by Bai Qi as he spoke.
"You know?"
Bai Qi was just stunned for a moment before realizing that since this girl could find this place, 99% of it was the "guide" of someone who had been here back then.
So could the person who came back then be the murderer of the person in the corner?
The answer is almost yes, but who cares?
"This man was a spy from Czechoslovakia who actually worked for France and disappeared in the spring of 1992."
As Yu Weiwei spoke, he put the flashlight aside, took out a pair of medical scissors from his breast pocket, and quickly cut open the suit on the body.
But what she said just now was said before she touched the body, which further confirmed Bai Zhi's previous guess.
"Is this what I can hear?" Bai Qi asked.
"Are you still planning to go to the Jifu Police Station to call the police?"
Yu Weiwei made a joke that was not very funny, "What he stole was Su... close the door."
Bai Zhi was stunned for a moment, then walked to the door and closed the heavy explosion-proof door.
"What he stole was the scientific research results of the Soviet Academy of Medical Sciences."
Yu Weiwei continued to say in Chinese, "It is the scientific research results related to the research after the Chernobyl accident in 1986."
"Are you sure I can listen?"
Bai Qi asked again. He and this beautiful girl with a cold temperament were not really acquaintances.
"Since I have decided to recruit you, I must let you know some inside information."
Yu Weiwei explained, "Unless you choose not to participate again after completing this cooperation, do you want to continue listening?"
Hearing this, Bai Qi subconsciously looked at the surrounding cabinets, and then nodded without hesitation, "Of course, as long as it doesn't cause trouble for you and myself and my family, why don't you listen?"
“Won’t cause trouble”
Yu Weiwei shook his head, placed the things found on the corpse next to him on the floor one by one, and continued, "The scientific research content is a new type of Cryptococcus that can absorb nuclear radiation and is very efficient in utilizing radiation."
"Ahem...that..."
Bai Qi had to interrupt the other party's explanation, "What major do you major in?"
"Medical biochemistry, what's wrong?" Yu Weiwei looked at Bai Qi in confusion.
“When I was in vocational high school, I majored in auto repair.”
Bai Qi laughed at herself, "Even if my uncle found someone to help me buy a diploma from Pheasant University in Russia, he majored in heavy equipment maintenance."
"I understand"
Yu Weiwei apologized and re-explained, “To put it simply, this is a fungus that is suspected to have originally grown in the high-radiation area of the Chernobyl nuclear accident site.
It can absorb nuclear radiation and convert it into energy... into fertilizer, yes, fertilizer for its own growth. "
"So powerful?"
Bai Zhi's eyes widened, "So as long as Chernobyl and the Radial Islands are full of this fungus... no, the Radial Islands will be fine."
"The ending is the same, but the process is definitely not as simple as you think."
Yu Weiwei tried his best to explain in a way that Bai Qi could understand, "It is essentially a fungus, a fungus that is dangerous to humans, and cultivating this fungus is not as simple as you think."
